comment: task recipe-data-b1 — the RM.Press lamp/TNT walks (Loader_Recipes_Vanilla.java:776-799 verbatim). Family expansion is the PORT-universe subset of the upstream ANY groups: ANY.Glowstone = {Glowstone, Gloomstone} (the 5 planet glowstones are the GC-compat faces absent from the port material tree) and ANY.SiO2 = {SiO2, NetherQuartz, CertusQuartz, Quartzite}. The ST.tag(1) selector legs are DROPPED — the JSON v1 row schema carries no damage/NBT faces and the configured Integrated Circuit is not expressible as a plain item id (the loom.json precedent; declared deviation: the rows answer without the circuit). DECLARED B2/POOL: the bullet-casing rows (Loader_Recipes_Other.java:657-668 — their mold input is size-0 not-consumable, a face the JSON v1 row schema does not carry either; the molds are registered by task explosives-chain), the :254-259 bullet retips (the round/bolt walk onto the blank bulletGt{Small,Medium,Large} of MT.Empty — the Or(PROJECTILES, EMPTY) carriers make them pourable but the pool card owns them). The food-mold event rows of Loader_Recipes_Food.java:146-152 are POURED-ELSEWHERE, not here (task food-t3-mold-rows retired this expired pool snapshot): the GT6RecipesBake runtime band transcribed them (GT6RecipesBake.java:274-291, task food-bake-recipes — the :146-:149 dough rows plus the :152 sugar-dough statement expanded over the three foodSugarDough members), and the JSON v1 schema carries no per-row notConsumed face (GT6RecipeMapJsonLoader.java:159-161) while the molds ride Recipe.sNotConsumable's shaping-tool arm (GT6RecipesBake.isFoodShapingTool) — a JSON row would eat the mold on every press, and the three-owner co-existence (GT6RecipeMapJsonLoader.java:84-90) has no content-level dedup to absorb a JSON twin of the java rows. Task toolhead-r11e-press-mortar reclaimed the tool-head statements as ONE representative row per upstream walk (the mortar.json :705-706 Blaze convention): :247-250 (the ANY.Iron raw/finished pickaxe-head bases, Diamond gem / Iron base representatives) and :252-253 (the arrow retips onto the plain Empty arrows). Task toolhead-family-closeout reclaims the :251 Empty-pickaxeGem-head retip — the OP.java:621 force row landed in GTMaterialItems.forceItemGeneration so the blank head exists, and the GT_Tool_PickaxeGem.java:30 drop ring returns exactly this blank: break -> blank -> press with 2 flawed gems -> new head. Still POOLED: the Shape_Extruder_Empty mold-synthesis chain (a crafting-table band, MultiItemTechnological.java:184-222 — zero Empty rows exist in the upstream extruder map, so extruder.json carries none; the r11c pooled face). Task explosives-chain reclaims the dynamite/boomstick rows (Loader_Recipes_Other.java:641-655): the ANY.SiO2 walk is the 4-statement x 4-port-member expansion (:642-645) plus the four Dynamite (:647-650) and four Dynamite_Strong (:652-655) rows — the same ST.tag selector-leg drop as the b1 rows above (the dust amounts 1-vs-2 keep the two families non-colliding without the circuit). Task press-electrodes reclaims the electrode band (MultiItemTechnological.java:502-543 — the b1 header's former "electrode station walk" pool note; the registration face is the GT6Electrodes thirteen, MIT :488-500): 31 statements whose five material walks (ANY.Cu :502/:521, ANY.Iron :506/:525, ANY.Diamond :509/:528, ANY.Rubber :513/:532, ANY.Emerald :515/:534) expand over the PORT-universe subset of each group folded by input item-truth — a member rides only when the port registers both its stick and its bolt (the GTMaterialItems live dump 2026-10-04): ANY.Cu = {AnnealedCopper, Copper}, ANY.Iron = 11 members, ANY.Diamond = 12, ANY.Rubber = {Rubber}, ANY.Emerald = 8, all item-true. Block 1 (:502-519, output x1) = 42 rows, block 2 (:521-539, output x2) = 43, block 3 (:540-543, the Ender dust/gem x4 quartet) = 4 — 89 rows total, every one the addRecipeX(T, 16, 64, ...) columns verbatim (16 EUt / 64 t). Still POOLED with the electrodes adjacent: the Handlers 11 prefix walk (Loader_Recipes_Handlers.java:248-259).
